The '''Galaxy Hammer''' is a [[Weapons#Club|club weapon]] that can be purchased for {{Price|75000}} at the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after obtaining a [[Galaxy Sword]].

It can be combined with {{Name|Galaxy Soul|3|class=inline}} and {{Name|Cinder Shard|60|class=inline}} in the [[Forge]] to create the {{Name|Infinity Gavel|class=inline}}.
